Passives: assumed 1%; verify values and exact board interfaces.
18 V is a DC design assumption, not a battery/transient limit.
Divider math does not protect GPIOs from faults or surges.
Optional OLED / DS18B20 are not part of this core netlist.
D1, TVS, reverse protection and relay are not selected/drawn.
Common ground and physical header map require verification.
Sensor VCC/GND are in CSV; inspect S_M bypass/filter; S_L rail TBD.
